method_findings: Completed OPEN excludes exit-minute H/L; cutoff includes full final minute. First tied peak and entry-first maximum are respected. Peak at minute OPEN excludes that minute later LOW; other peak-minute LOW is bounded.

Unresolved intraminute protective endpoint conservatively reports full-MAE-lower tozero, not exact peak timing. Bound source event MFE and MAE envelopes before reporting. Prior strictly larger peak may remain identified.

Retrospective peak cost burden and giveback are movement descriptions, never fills or optimized exits. Median bound endpoints, gross-positive direction and best/worst per-unit net admissions preserve endpoint status.

Caller must report all-admission and completed-only populations separately. Active-week/calendar-zero denominators, absolute individualcashPnL concentration and matched-event OLS endpoint scenarios are defined with dependence/noncausal limits.

10/30 reference-cost rows condition on existing admissions/prices, not funded simulations. Existing20/40/60/80 funded screens/gates/verdicts remain authoritative. Raw eligibleBUY availability clocks include warmup indexwarmup-1 and final no-nextopen flag under existing fixedUTC labels.
limits: Read-only descriptive augmentation defined after existing KAMA outcome; no new strategy, threshold/filter, gate, trial or route to rescue/promotion. Timing must be disclosed.

OHLC enumeration covers admissible two-extreme order paths for fullminutes and confirms these200 bounds; intraminute exit envelope intentionally broader. No tick/executable peak or common joint attainment of separate bounds is inferred.

Module assumes original validated retained OHLCV panel and immutable eventledger; its envelope check is not full source-receipt/timestamp validation. Application must bind exact result/data/receipt/module/method hashes.
event_summary does not automatically split completed-only events; caller is responsible for both populations and for aggregating per-event positive/pre-MFE metrics.

OLS endpoint scenarios are sensitivities, not confidence intervals or causal alpha. Absolute eventcash concentration reflects source sizing. Fixed reference-price cost arithmetic changes no funding/admissions.
No raw path application performed here; final integration/source/test binding and outputs still require review before claims.

resolved_findings.resolution: Exact minute OPEN equality now enforced before excursion calculation. The101versus100 regression uses internally consistent MFE/MAE envelopes and is rejected. Method explicitly refuses intraminute/legacy eight-hour entry adapters.
